context: CartProvider exposes cart items and mutators through context to the whole app. Many components far down the tree read from useCart().
explanation: Safe to merge. Wrapping the context value in useMemo (keyed on its own dependencies) stops a new value object from being created on every provider render, so consumers only re-render when items or total actually change. Stabilizing addItem/removeItem with useCallback and throwing from useCart when used outside a provider are both solid, low-risk improvements.
